title: Your Eyes Can See One Photon
hook: Your eyes can catch one particle of light.
script: Your eyes can catch one particle of light. You do not need a bright room, or even a dim one. In total darkness, your eyes can still register a single photon. So how can anything that small make you see? Cells at the back of your eye switch on when one photon lands. On a clear, dark night, that is enough to spot a single candle flame from miles away. Is anything built by humans that sensitive? Almost no camera works that well in the dark. So when you stare into the dark, you are using one of the most sensitive detectors you own.
